description: A provider executes a runtime-requested operation AFTER all required runtime and external governance checks have completed. Neutral: no vendor coupling.

failure_signaling.unknown_exception: wrapped by the runtime; never surfaced raw

neutrality: No OpenAI/Anthropic/GitHub/cloud/database specifics. Concrete providers live outside this package.

attempt_telemetry.emitted_once_per: actual provider.execute invocation (success, expected failure, timeout, provider error, raw exception)
attempt_telemetry.attempt_number: runtime-authoritative; incremented per retry; retried attempts are NEVER collapsed
no_attempt_when: exact-action clearance/integrity rejection (fails closed before invocation)
attempt_telemetry.neutral_usage_rule: A provider MAY attach an opaque mapping at ToolResult.metadata['token_usage']; the runtime forwards it verbatim as ProviderAttempt.neutral_usage and NEVER interprets provider-specific token fields. Absent/non-mapping => None (unknown, never fabricated).
attempt_telemetry.robustness: A raising observer is swallowed; telemetry can never change the provider action or break execution.

observation_failure_reporting.fail_open: a raising observer never re-executes the provider, erases its result, or changes retry behavior
observation_failure_reporting.surfacing: exactly one structured failure per observer failure when a reporter is configured; a raising reporter is contained and never masks the provider result
observation_failure_reporting.safe_payload: carries safe identity + error_kind (a FIXED code from the closed ObservationFailureKind allowlist) ONLY; NEVER the exception class name/module/message/args/repr or any provider payload (N2)
observation_failure_reporting.no_signal_when: no provider was invoked (governance/exact-action rejection, provider-not-found)

classification.mapping: isinstance against a closed allowlist (never type(exc).__name__); unmatched -> OBSERVER_EXCEPTION
